title:
Stage 1 forge tier — increment 2f: relax routing (REQ-8) PLUS the L3/L4 ladder build-out. Authoritative spec: .design/stage1-forge-tier.md REQ-8 + AC-12; sequencing in .design/stage1-forge-tier-kickoff-plan.md. The RFC-1 body (GH issue #2) is the authority for the new ladder. Builds on all merged predecessors (foundation #20 .. 2e #45). REQ-8a (the spine lemmas r_relax_sound + rencode_sound) ALREADY landed in the foundation — consume them, do not redo. Follow the ACToR read-write-verify-commit loop; commit per coherent sub-unit; self-verify before each commit; revert anything that fails. If low on time or budget, STOP at a sub-unit boundary and report what landed.

STANDING SELF-VERIFY RULES (do not skip — these caused CI-red in prior increments):
- Run python3 tooling/doc-drift.py and RE-PIN the audited-sha of EVERY design doc whose governed source you touch; run req-registry.py --check; finish 0-drift.
- EVERY new test that invokes lake / the Lean spine MUST open with the lake_present() skip-guard (eprintln SKIP + return) like the sibling live engine::tests — CI test-shards have NO spine, so an unguarded live test FAILS instead of skipping.

SCOPE: REQ-8 relax routing + the L4 ladder build-out (below). OUT OF SCOPE: lemma library (increment 3, REQ-9).

PART A — REQ-8b/8c relax routing:
1. The relaxable syntactic classifier: universally-quantified, polynomial atoms, NO div/mod/shifts/casts in atoms.
2. A NEW EngineName::Nlsat Engine impl issuing a direct Z3 nlsat-tactic (QF_NRA) query (Q-NLSAT) — nlsat is unreachable today (Fragment::admits returns all classes, default_engines is [Verus]); narrow the fragment predicate + add the conditional dispatch in check.rs. Attribution reuses Certificate::with_engine_attribution.
3. The integrality check on real countermodels (Q8: rounding + radius-2 Z^n box, 1s budget).
4. RealWitness production: a true-over-Z false-over-R claim (e.g. forall n. n*n != 2) yields the RealWitness verdict (the CertVerdict variant exists from the foundation) carrying the raw real point, escalated to the forge as goal metadata — never a Counterexample.

PART B — the L3/L4 ladder build-out (deferred here from the #249/ladder review; the user chose 'reconcile as part of 2f'):
5. Introduce Level::L4 in manifest.rs (the enum is L0/L1/L2/L3 today — no L4). Per the new RFC: L3 = Verus/Z3 SOLVER proof; L4 = KERNEL-GROUNDED (the nlsat route's trust_profile is solver(nlsat) + spine-lemma(kernel)). The nlsat-relaxed-with-spine-lemma discharge certifies L4. AC-12: the isqrt example certifies L4 push-button with engine: nlsat; the relaxable check admits isqrt postconditions and rejects a div-containing clause.
6. Reconcile the v1 ladder docs to the new RFC: thermite-design.md's ladder diagram (currently shows only L1/L2/L3) and .design/forge/degrade-ladder.md (the L3->L2->L1 DOWNWARD degrade) predate L4 — update both to show L4 above L3 + the upward forge-escalation ('out-of-cage escalates UP to the forge'), citing RFC-1 / GH #2 as the authority. Re-pin their doc-drift.
7. Re-anchor the divergence_249_axiom_mask pin's level language to the new ladder: its 'certifies at L3' wording is v1-era; the interactive-Lean-replay path it guards is the kernel/forge tier (L4-shaped). The soundness req is 'never Proved at any proven rung (L3 or L4)'. (The pin PASSES on HEAD with verus+lake+spine — do NOT break it; just re-anchor the level language + assert it is not certified at any proven rung.)

GAUNTLET before each commit: cargo test -p forge; clippy -p forge --all-targets -- -D warnings; fmt --check; for any Lean touch, lake build + axiom probe; doc-drift 0-drift; req-registry --check clean; forge check over conformance still matches all v1 golden certs with oracle_subset byte-identical for v1 items (adding Level::L4 must not perturb v1 items, which stay L3). AC-12: relaxable unit tests (admits isqrt postconditions, rejects div clause); isqrt certifies L4 via nlsat; forall n. n*n!=2 yields RealWitness carrying the real point, never Counterexample; the axiom probe already covers r_relax_sound + rencode_sound (foundation). No stubs/TODOs.

REGISTRY: register REQ-8 as REQ-S1-8 (shipped) with typed evidence; regenerate the status view; req-registry.py --check clean. No hand-written ## REQ status table.

SCOPE GUARDS: no combinator cage/menu change (the relaxable check + nlsat are a NEW engine route, not a cage edit); do NOT flip the README/docs headline (that is the G1 gate only, R-GATE-1 — the ladder-doc reconcile in PART B updates the INTERNAL design docs thermite-design.md/degrade-ladder.md, NOT the public README headline); never stage .crosslink/hook-config.json or .claude/settings.json. NOTE: git push is blocked for you by policy — commit locally, end with a clear summary, and the orchestrator pushes + opens the PR. One branch; this is the relax + L4 increment (2f).
